test_pz_nn_RenameAxes: test the pz.nn.RenameAxes class to rename named array axes from old names to new names
test_pz_nn_NamedEinsum: test the pz.nn.NamedEinsum class to perform einsum operations on named-shape arrays
test_pz_nn_Linear: test the pz.nn.Linear.from_config method to create a linear layer with named input and output axes
test_pz_nn_Affine: test the pz.nn.Affine.from_config method to create an affine layer with bias and linear transformation
test_pz_nn_Residual: test the pz.nn.Residual class to wrap a sublayer and add its output to the input
